# Synthetic send model fixture

The numbers in `send_model_v1_coefficients.csv`, `send_model_v1_meta.json`, `send_model_v1_bootstrap.csv` and
`send_batter_advance_v1.csv` are synthetic: round values chosen for tests. They follow the structure of the send
model exports but are not estimated from any data. The five bootstrap replicates scale the estimates by 0.90, 0.95,
1.00, 1.05 and 1.10.
